data_plan.cleaning: strip headers, quoted lines and signature; full and truncated normalized body plus subject/message-ID union
data_plan.newsgroup_split: original train component hash partition; official test future; no within-train chronology

evaluation.bootstrap_method: class-stratified source-component percentile; per-example seed average; higher quantile
evaluation.cpu_aggregation: sum over three paired seeds per task/head
evaluation.cpu_scope: dense construction, planning and execution; common encoder and warmup reported separately

fixed_library.independence: same preexisting SHA256 sign library; no learned/optimized directions and no reseeding
fixed_library.physical_action: one first post-Adam dt*u; zero suffix; abs(u_j)<=1/sqrt(p)

label_access: runner audits deny validation_labels.json and final_labels.json; complete run hash seal before either label payload; evaluator does not choose candidate

mpc.budget: same per-step coordinate box; eight actual Adam updates; repeated interventions recorded separately from single-impulse P0
mpc.cost: actual CPU/wall including own reference, chosen model derivatives, solver and advance; common encoder/projection/warmup reported separately
mpc.limitation: dense full-state preparation for every controller; does not establish autonomous compact observer or cheaper deployment
mpc.replan: every actual step rebuild reference from complete current theta/m/v and Adam clock, execute only first impulse, then observe/replan

prediction_freeze: all49 impulses and five predictions saved before each fixed-anchor execution; all31 pressure plans sealed before each checkpoint execution; MPC replans causally from actual preceding state

pressure.failed_plan: preserve infeasible and unresolved; no zero substitution or outcome-based retry
pressure.threshold: original warmup old-probe NLL; strict positive first crossing tau; no threshold rescaling

projection.method: Gaussian QR; diagonal R sign fixed; label-independent

publication_scope: additive V4 code and compact evidence; preserve prior source/results
registration: local protocol and remote protocol commit before new encoder/model outcomes; not independent preregistration
retention_anchor: warmup old-probe NLL without margin relaxation

solver.algorithm: bounded convex one-impulse squared-hinge QP; SLSQP candidate with independent multiplier and strong-convexity certificate; bounded LP/Farkas infeasibility witness
solver.failure_policy: retain certified tangent infeasibility separately from unresolved numerical failure; no fallback action or discarded condition
solver.initialization: deterministic solver initialization; no previous candidate hidden warm start
solver.scope: floating arithmetic certificate on declared tangent problem; hard inequalities enlarged by stated numerical tolerance; no nonlinear or interval-roundoff guarantee

newsgroups.components: full cleaned body and normalized subject union across train/test; reject cross-split and label conflicts; unique component per selected row
newsgroups.split: old/current fixed component-hash partition of official train; future official test
newsgroups.text: strip headers, quoted lines and footer; deterministic first6000 characters; duplicate truncated inputs excluded
newsgroups.time_limitation: archive strips Date and Message-ID; no within-train chronology claim

uci.components: full story/title union; exclude conflicts/crossmonth and all known legacy5,V1,V2,V3,retention480 components
uci.source_only_feasibility_amendment: May/June original proposal impossible after prior-component exclusion: June health=0. Counts/months fixed before encoder or new model outcomes.
